comment: The default real hosts for the BUNDLE scenario that talks to the Internet; "required" hosts must answer. recorded_top is the topmost certificate each host sent when it was added, with its issuer and fingerprint. NET_TLS_INTERNET_HOSTS=h1,h2,... replaces this list for a run.

hosts.recorded_top: CN=GTS Root R4,O=Google Trust Services LLC,C=US
CN=ISRG Root X2,O=Internet Security Research Group,C=US
hosts.recorded_top_issuer: CN=ISRG Root X1,O=Internet Security Research Group,C=US

hosts.recorded_top: CN=SSL.com TLS ECC Root CA 2022,O=SSL Corporation,C=US
hosts.recorded_top_issuer: CN=AAA Certificate Services,O=Comodo CA Limited,L=Salford,ST=Greater Manchester,C=GB
